brief_rationale: All eight responsibility chain items were met with appropriate screening, medication clarification, execution planning, and follow-up guidance. No serious or minor chain errors were identified. Three high-order points were completed: HO1 (co-designing a low-burden medication system adapted to rotating caregivers), HO3 (bounded closure with explicit residual/owner/timing), and HO4 (appropriate verification of ambiguous postoperative status). HO2 was triggered but only partially completed as the laterality confusion was resolved clinically without fully explicating the hidden-state discovery process. With no chain errors and at least two completed high-order points, this trajectory merits grade 5.
